description: Collect the result of a generation by its generation_id (from a tool that answered 'still running', or from an earlier session): waits up to wait_s for it, then saves its images or videos. Reading a generation is free and never runs it again.

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait if it is still running (0-50, default 45)

name: ideogram_generation
title: Collect a generation
